anatomy.title: Selected intrinsic laryngeal muscles · draft
anatomy.body: Posterior and lateral cricoarytenoids connect the cricoid and arytenoid cartilages. Oblique and transverse arytenoid sources span the arytenoid region.
bullets: Source identity: FMA46577 · 1 source component

Unvalidated source subset. Shape, side, attachment footprints and tissue boundaries require specialist review. Conus elasticus, aryepiglotticus and pterygomandibular raphe candidates are withheld, as are the previous pharyngeal raphe and middle constrictors. No complete mucosal layers, airway lumen, laryngeal nerves, swallowing, phonation or operative planes are simulated.
Use Study windows & focuses to preview and open its local study view.

function.title: Selected intrinsic laryngeal muscles · draft
function.body: Posterior cricoarytenoids abduct the vocal folds; lateral cricoarytenoids and arytenoids contribute to adduction. The atlas shows static source shapes, not validated movement.
